levels.description: Ice Monkeys in radius create orbiting Ice Fragment projectiles when they attack.
levels.effect: Every time that an Ice Monkey within Silas' range attacks, that Ice Monkey gains an Ice Fragment projectile that orbits around its range, just like Mystic Twister. It can have up to 3 orbiting Ice Fragments. Unlike ice shards from the eponymous upgrade, an Ice Fragment has 6 pierce, 1 damage, +1 Frozen damage, and rehit after 1 second, popping all except Purple and White.

levels.description: Frostbite ability: Silas can hit all Bloons while active. When hitting frozen Bloons, target takes extra damage based on remaining freeze time.
levels.effect: Gains the Frostbite ability: For 8 seconds, main attack damages all Bloon types and does 10 extra Frozen damage for every second remaining rounded up, but clears the freeze time before main attack freezing. Cooldown of 30 seconds.

levels.description: Ice Walls form on the track near Silas. Ice Walls push back and freeze Bloons. MOABs are frozen for less time.
levels.effect: Randomly places Ice Walls around the track near Silas, at a rate of every 10 seconds. Affected Bloons push back at about -400% speed briefly for 0.1s, and freeze them for 3 seconds, penetrating 10 layers. MOABs are frozen for half duration and consume 30 pierce, but will not freeze other blimps. Will not target Whites, Zebras, Leads, DDTs, and BADs, but will target and freeze Purples. Ice Walls last for 15 seconds, carry over 1 round, and has 15 pierce.

levels.description: White Bloons are less resistant to cold attacks. Monkeys that freeze Bloons freeze them for longer.
levels.effect: All White-properties Bloons have a 50% chance of being damaged by any freezing attack. All towers other than himself and Paragons gain +50% freeze duration.

levels.description: Silas can attack Bloons in the range of Ice Monkeys anywhere.
levels.effect: Works similarly to Monkey Sub's Advanced Intel. Extended range by allowing Silas to target all bloons within the radius of any Ice Monkeys on screen,

levels.description: Frozen Cascade ability: Creates a shattering blast of ice around Silas, and then for other Ice Monkeys spreading out from Silas, Frozen Bloons take extra damage from ability.
levels.effect: Gain a Frozen Cascade ability: Creates a shattering blast of ice around Silas, and then for other Ice Monkeys spreading out from Silas, up to 9 of the closest Ice Monkeys. All blasts have 40 blast radius, 45 pierce, 20 damage against all except Lead, and +15 Frozen damage. Affected non-blimps have up to 10 layers frozen for 9 seconds, Cooldown of 60 seconds.

levels.description: Buffs the ranges of all Ice Monkeys & grants more Hero XP for each Tier 3 Ice Monkey.
levels.effect: All Ice Monkeys gain +5 range. Silas gains an extra 5% Hero XP for every Tier 3 Ice Monkey on screen, capping at 50%.

levels.description: Frozen Bloons damaged during Frostbite take more damage. Ice Shards damage & pierce increased.
levels.effect: Frostbite increases Frozen damage per second remaining from 10 to 15. Ice Shards increase extra Frozen damage from +1 to +3 and pierce from 6 to 12.

levels.description: Frozen Burial ability: Immediately freezes and damages all Bloons, dealing far more damage to already frozen Bloons. Then fills the track with Ice Walls.
levels.effect: Freezes all Bloons on screen just like Absolute Zero, but also deals +60 damage to Frozen, and freezes 10 layers for 6 seconds with only 3 seconds versus MOAB-class. After 0.5s, Ice Walls are scattered around Silas evenly along the track, just like Mega Massive Munitions Factory's Spikeageddon ability. The distance between each Ice Wall is approximately 25 units. Cooldown is 90 seconds.

levels.description: Slowing aura around Silas slows Bloons more, and can slow MOABs.
levels.effect: Arctic aura slows down Bloons by 20% instead of 15%, and all MOAB-class Bloons are slowed by 10%.

levels.description: Ice Walls can hit more Bloons and last longer. Rimed and frozen Bloons take more damage from main attack.
levels.effect: Ice Walls last for 20 seconds instead of 15, pierce increased from 15 to 30, consumes less pierce on blue MOABs (5 instead of 15), and can affect BFBs and ZOMGs, but not DDTs. BFBs consume 15 pierce and ZOMGs consume 30 pierce. Cold explosion does 5 damage instead of 1.

levels.description: Ice Monkey Tier 5's are cheaper, and you can build a 4th Tier 5 of any path. White Bloons lose all resistance to cold attacks.
levels.effect: Cost of all Ice Monkey Tier 5 upgrades are reduced by 25% while he is on screen with at least this level. If he is on screen, he will also allow purchase of a second of any Tier 5 Ice Monkey that owned by the player (e.g. buying two Icicle Impales, but not two Icicle Impales and two Absolute Zeroes). If in Co-Op, having at least one Silas with this level or greater will allow all players to buy a second of any T5 Ice Monkey. All Bloons completely lose their White Bloon immunities.

levels.description: Ice Monkeys create more orbiting Ice Fragments when they attack.
levels.effect: Ice Fragment lifespan increased from 10 to 17 seconds, and the max Ice Fragments for all Tier 2 and above Ice Monkeys is increased from 3 to 6. 4th to 6th fragments move anti-clockwise in a faster, wider radius.

levels.description: Frozen Bloons take more damage from all abilities. Frostbite lasts longer, and Frozen Cascade and Frozen Burial have shorter cooldowns.
levels.effect: All of Silas' abilities deal more damage to Frozen. Frostbite lasts 12 seconds instead of 8 and each does extra +25 Frozen damage instead of +10, Frozen Cascade cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s and does +30 Frozen damage instead of +15, and Frozen Burial cooldown reduced from 90s to 75s with +200 Frozen damage instead of +60.

levels.description: Main attack does more area damage to rimed and frozen Bloons, and orbiting Ice Fragments do more damage to frozen Bloons.
levels.effect: Cold explosion damage increased from 5 to 10. Ice Fragment pierce increased from 12 to 24, and does +6 Frozen damage instead of +1.

levels.description: Tier 3 Ice Monkeys create even more orbiting Ice Shards.
levels.effect: Ice Fragments last for 24 seconds, and all Tier 3 and above Ice Monkeys can have up to 9 Ice Fragments. 7th to 9th Ice Fragments are further away from the first two orbitals and have even faster projectile speed.

levels.description: Slowing aura around Silas slows Bloons even more. Rimed Bloons take even more damage from cold attacks, and main attack does more area damage to rimed and frozen Bloons.
levels.effect: Arctic aura slows non-blimps by 30%, and MOAB-class by 15%. Rimed Bloons take extra +5 damage from Shatter/Cold/Metal Freeze/Glacier/Metal Glacier Freeze/Arctic attack instead of 1. Cold explosion deals 15 damage.

levels.description: Ice Walls have more pierce & lifespan, Ice Fragments pierce more and deal even more damage to frozen Bloons
levels.effect: Ice Wall pierce increased from 30 to 60, and lifespan increased from 20 to 30 seconds. Ice Fragments does +8 Frozen damage instead of +6 and pierce from 18 to 24.

levels.description: Frozen Bloons take even more damage during Frostbite. Silas creates Ice Walls more often. Monkeys that freeze Bloons freeze them yet longer again.
levels.effect: Frostbite bonus Frozen damage increased from +25 to +50, Ice Walls are produced much faster (10s → 7s), and freeze duration of all freezes other than himself and Paragons increased by +150% instead of +50%.

data.name: Dan D'Monke
data.abilities: Transform (Level 3) Reposition / Volant Strike (Level 7) Rabble Rouser / Berserk Frenzy (Level 10)

levels.description: Dan D'Monke stabs at Bloons with his sword.
levels.effect: Dan D'Monke has a short-ranged melee attack with 1 damage and 4 pierce. Attacks every 0.5s. This melee attack is shot like a short-ranged projectile, taking delay before hitting further targets.

levels.description: Dan D'Monke gets his eye in and is able to wield his sword to hit more Bloons at once.
levels.effect: Increase Dan D'Monke's sword pierce from 4 to 6.

Unlocks a new form, The Masqued Macaque, who has a slower attack speed (every 1 second) but 2 damage and 9 pierce. The Masqued Macaque also uses lightning every third attack, forking twice up to three times (similarly to Corvus's Spear lightning). Lightning does one damage and can hit up to 15 targets. Both forms gain Transform, which transforms between the two forms while unleashing 5 arcs of lightning that do 1 damage each. Every fourth attack from Dan D'Monke applies blowback to non-MOAB class Bloons.

Dan D'Monke's sword damage is increased to 2, and he occasionally places net traps which will trigger when at least 4 bloons pass by, slowing non-blimp Bloons inside an 18 radius radius, slowing them by 50% for 12 seconds. The Masqued Macaque's sword damage is increased to 4, and his lightning damage is increased to 2. Lightning from the Transform ability is increased to 2.

Dan D'Monke and The Masqued Macaque place a shield at the end of each track, reducing the health lost from the first non-MOAB class Bloon leaked by half (rounded down), then pushing back non-blimps by 20 units and stunning other Bloons close to the exit for 3 seconds. After 12 seconds, this shield fully recharges and restores itself. Does not affect Purple or Lead, but always affects Camo.
Increases Dan D'Monke's sword damage to 3. Increases The Masqued Macaque's sword damage to 6, and his lightning damage to 3. Transform's lightning now deals 2 damage.

Gains two new abilities, one for each form. Dan D'Monke's Reposition functions mechanically identically to Support Chinook's Chinook ability but with faster teleportation, while The Masqued Macaque's Volant Strike repositions himself, attacking in his range to deal 75 damage to all affected Bloons and stun them for 6 seconds, with less stun duration on larger blimps. Has 35 pierce.

Dan D'Monke unleashes a shockwave every twenty-fourth attack, causing affected Bloons in range to take +1 damage for a short time and blowing them back; this affects all except ZOMGs, DDTs, and BADs. The Masqued Macaque stomps every tenth attack, dealing 1 damage to Bloons in range and knocking some of them backwards.
Dan D'Monke creates a 2 hit sword combo attack on every third attack, with 0.05s after the first hit, and must play before cooling off the next attack. The Masqued Macque attacks faster.

Gains two new abilities, one for each form. Dan D'Monke's Rabble Rouser grants nearby towers 50% damage increased but 20% attack slower within his range, triggering any passive abilities towers with no lives lost, and prevents all affected towers from being stunned, stopped, or interrupted from certain map mechanics and/or those given from Boss Bloons. The Masqued Macque's Berzerk Frenzy ability allow him to pursue the Bloons to swipe them with 30 damage and 18 pierce at quick rates, before returning back to his old location.
Increased Dan D'Monke's range and pierce and increased The Masqued Macque Range and pierce of sword attacks, chain lightning, Stomp damage and Transform upon ability damage.

Just before leaking to an exit, trigger the Quick Thinking passive. Up to 40 Bloons are blown back, with blimps taking more pierce, and leak damage is halved (rounded down). Cooldown of 60 seconds and begins while the passive ability is in play.
Dan D'Monke gains a flurry of jabs, creating an extra attack after 0.05 seconds that swipes again a third time. Masqued Macaque attacks even faster.

After leaking, he will heal 1 life per second from the last leaked Bloon, up to 100 lives for that Bloon. Masqued Macaque will sometimes smacks a base MOAB that pushes it backwards and deal 40 damage to Bloons it keeps hitting, every 0.1s, and pushing back more Bloons with pushback; it can re-hit Bloons.
Gains even more pierce for all sword attacks. All blowback effects including his own gain 40% blowback distance.
Even more damage!
Post-transformation buff lasts for 15 seconds instead of 9. His Level 7 ability cooldowns are reduced from 30 to 15 seconds, and Level 10 ability cooldowns reduced from 60 to 45 seconds.
Dan D'Monke makes 2 jabs every 2nd attack and 3 jabs every 3rd attack, with the triple jab prioritizing over the double jab. Masqued Macaque attacks even faster.

Just like the scaling effects of Avatar of Wrath's wrath damage and Elite Defender's distance-per-speed, both forms deal more damage per "leak damage" (not the same as RBE) and +1% additive attack speed per 1% distance the furthest Bloon from the start is. Dan and Masqued Macaque scale differently.
